privacy.title: Privacy Policy & Data Security Standards
privacy.summary: At MPG Event Planner, we uphold the highest standards of data protection, client confidentiality, and digital privacy across our event production, digital quotation systems, and corporate communications in Cambodia.
privacy.scope_desc: This Privacy Policy applies to all personal information, corporate project briefs, and browsing telemetry collected through our website (mpgevent.com), digital inquiry forms, direct messaging channels (Telegram, WhatsApp, Email, Phone), and physical on-site production operations managed by MPG Event Planner.
privacy.section1_desc: We collect information voluntarily provided when you request a proposal, contact our team, or contract our event services: (a) Contact Identifiers: Full name, company or organization name, official email, phone number, and Telegram handle; (b) Event Brief Specifications: Event category (grand opening, summit, gala, wedding), proposed dates, target guest count, venue preferences, stage/AV requirements, and budget parameters; (c) Media & Event Documentation: Photographic and video footage captured during public or corporate events (subject to prior client approval and NDA agreements); (d) Technical Telemetry: Anonymized browser type, operating system, device classification, referrer channels, and consented cookie identifiers.
privacy.section2_title: Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing
privacy.section2_desc: We process your information strictly for legitimate commercial and operational purposes: formulating customized event budgets, engineering floor plans, securing venue logistics, coordinating sound/light staging crews, delivering contracts, issuing tax invoices, and responding to inquiries. We do not sell, rent, monetize, or trade client data with third-party brokers or advertisers under any circumstances.
privacy.section3_desc: Our website employs lightweight, privacy-first first-party cookies to remember your consent preferences and, upon your explicit acceptance, track anonymous route interactions. This telemetry helps our engineering team optimize page load speeds and proposal tools. We do not embed invasive marketing pixels (such as Meta Pixel or TikTok tracking) or cross-site tracking scripts.
privacy.section4_desc: We understand that corporate product launches, executive summits, and private gatherings often involve proprietary business information and unannounced brand assets. MPG Event Planner routinely enters into formal Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) to guarantee that all creative concepts, stage renderings, VIP guest lists, and financial figures remain strictly confidential.
privacy.section5_title: Cloud Infrastructure, Encryption & Crew Access Control
privacy.section5_desc: All inquiry records and operational logs are stored in secure cloud database clusters featuring AES-256 encryption at rest and TLS 1.3 encryption in transit. System access is restricted via Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), ensuring that only verified project managers, technical directors, and authorized administrators can access event files.
privacy.section6_desc: We retain client data only for as long as necessary to fulfill the intended purpose: general quotation requests that do not proceed to execution are automatically archived and purged after 12 months. Executed event contracts, floor plans, and billing statements are securely retained for up to 3 years for tax compliance and warranty support, after which they are permanently deleted.
privacy.section7_title: Your Privacy Rights & Subject Access Requests
privacy.section7_desc: You retain full ownership and control over your personal data. At any time, you have the right to: (1) Request a copy of all personal records we hold regarding your inquiries; (2) Request immediate rectification of outdated or inaccurate information; (3) Request the permanent erasure of your data from our active databases; (4) Revoke or modify your cookie telemetry consent via the on-page Privacy Manager.
